Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for all contributions to this repository.

- Content is tool-agnostic Markdown; do not tie rules or prompts to a single agent product.
- Apply [evidence-policy](../rules/evidence-policy.md) to every finding and compatibility claim.
- Default to read-only inspection; ask before destructive or externally visible actions.
- Never add credentials, private URLs, or corporate information.
